item.title: Reasolutions
item.dc:creator: basyt
item.content:encoded:
A resolution is a re-solution of some sort and thus not explicitly needed if you can be perfect the first time itself.

So then what proof do you have of your perfection?

Well I am me so I am perfect. But see, I get no satisfaction of being perfect. I know how perfectly ironic it is but I want to improve. I want to, before I die, find just one fault in me. And there have been times in my life when the only thing keeping me alive was the fact that I wanted to find a reason to not live. I have not yet found one.

See all that one really needs to do is to trust their instincts.

Yes, but I like the feeling of having my instincts vindicated by my reason. I like it when I over analyze things only to find that my rash decision was perfectly justified. I am lately coming to the conclusion that it is this that probably is what it means to be a man to me. I am slow because I want to absorb all the information currents flowing around me. And it sounds a very painful activity. What do you have to do so that you learn everything? Nothing actually, as it turns out. You already know everything, you just have to find the words to express it.

One naively thinks, that maybe I need to learn a new language to do that. Maybe I can be more direct lets say, if I can use a more direct language with a simpler syntactical structure, a smaller basis of somewhat interchangeable vowels.

I mean how hard can it be to learn to sing the songs of a language that has 5 fucking vowels?

Confusion is the byproduct of learning, if one is confused then it only serves to indicate that you are getting something righter than somebody who can find no fault with the semantic structure of whatever it is you are trying to learn. See because incompleteness basically arises because one mans lemma is another's theorem which their children adopt as axioms.

So this is it for now.

Abd-el

item.title: The Stupid Crow
item.dc:creator: basyt
item.content:encoded:
There is a crow in IITK. It is actually a marvelous technological innovation of modern art. Well it is not quite that, it is just a folded sheet of metal sitting on a dome and colored black.

When I was but a child, it used to make me deeply uncomfortable. It was art, everyone around me would tell me in unison. But I then could not figure out how a black sheet of metal could ever be considered art.

I finally decided to you know, try to find out if there is any component of “art” in the stupid crow. So I decided to give it one final look. So, the first thing I had to figure out was, well how do you approach a masterful work of art.

This rather unnecessary step was actually necessary in my frame of reference. This is so because, I had no ideas about the kind of revelations that would reveal to me.

It was then that I recollected of the Monolith. You see, Arthur C Clarke once postulated that the fact that we as a species survive could only have the following simple explaination(this according to me is the correct spelling, because in my mind I go, yes I belong to the nation of explainers):

You see, there is a species of supra-intelligent beings a kind of ubermensch that gave us all of our intelligence. What noble beasts are these to share so precious a gift with a species that is generally so frivolous with its own blessings?

Well, they used to be kinda like the Sovereign in Mass Effect (it is pretty) but then they started playing a different game wherein they would attach themselves directly to a star and then use that mass energy to directly bring to reality any shape of any form of matter as they willed. This is the room that the protagonist woke up to in 2001.

So later he becomes a being that sort of transcends reality and just stood there and blotted out the sun. But anyways, the monolith TAUGHT humans the tao of tools.

I have always wondered about how do you go about teaching an ape to use a tool? It seems to me patently obvious that everybody could basically use anything to PRETEND to do whatever they want to do. Because one man’s lighter really IS another’s lightsaber.

So anyways, hoping for a tremendous revelation to dawn on me any moment now, I approached the monolith by trying to act in a manner that was in my opinion dead center of the behaviors of an ape and that of Capt. Shepard.

I fully expected to be beamed up to an alien television channel and informed exactly how foolish and delusional I really am. Sadly no such beaming seemed forthcoming. So then I began to look at the structure a tad bit more, rationally.

I asked my sense i.e. the sanense that I really am, about how and what meanings could I attach to the structure that I saw standing proudly in front of me. So I decided to risk taking a closer look. All I found was rust.

While at first this was a bit saddening, I could rationalize it. It is not like IITK has an infinite budget, the thing is that, see, the total number of students has increased many folds, I am not exactly sure how much and I don’t like to hazard guesses in so cavalier a manner. Now I earlier used to naively think that one can just put as many students as one wants in an institute. If a lecture hall that can hold 600 students seems to fall short then we can build two new lecture halls of an even bigger capacity and have two professors teach them. If even that fails there are always the old and the open air auditorium. But lately I think, that in pursuit of a mathematical simplicity I somewhat ignored the razor of Ockham(it was a expansion for Oblivion that basically added a cave with a razor and a couple of creeps to the game, but somehow it was for me one of the most fun, because I had decided that I wanted to UNDERSTAND the razor and if that meant to retrieve an actual virtual razor from the bottom of a dark pit filled with creeps, well I would just have to do that won’t I?) as it applies to natural phenomena.

Anyways here is another shot from some distance.

 

Now, so far so good, but then I noticed on the dome a region that had a different isotropy from the rest of the dome.

The writing is pretty much cleared away and for the life of me I cannot remember the words inscribed on it. But then I remember reading the digits 85 on it. So I know that they meant 1985. Which is a weird year right, its only real claim to fame is that it lies between 1984 and 1986. Just one of those years that just pass by with nothing really happening. Well, that is probably because of the fact that the years it distinguishes were filled with so many frantic actions that the universe paused to collect its thoughts and decided that for this year all it really wants to do is just fucking breathe.

It was then, I realized that there is a name on it, that I couldn’t quite make out. That led to the realization that somebody who passed out of IITK must have made it. Oh, I says to myself, here lies the work of a brethren and a comrade. And I understood.

item.title: Inquisitiveness
item.dc:creator: basyt
item.content:encoded:
Every change is a potential puzzle. One solves puzzles by thinking. One thinks by either their instincts or by their words. One comes to the same conclusion either way. This is the criteria for obtaining a correct solution.

It is a more purer mathematics than philosophy can ever hope to be. One must to neglect ones feelings and emotions and other complimentary garbage that is similarly evocative and learn to ignore the cries of ones conscience. It does not really do much. When I hear the word nobel my mind thinks that it is a variation on no bell, because they are just so similar.

I grew up thinking that synonyms and antonyms are similies. Similies are word that when taken mean in the same neighborhood. I cannot really distinguish between “opposites” because my mind finds an overwhelming burden of similarities that in my mind I cannot convince myself to ignore. Everybody I see look and I mean really look like my own reflections under a suitably transforming mirror. I cannot thus bring myself to do anything that in any foreseeably predictable way affects them in any particular way. Except the changes that I can truly convince myself that yes no matter how huge an ensemble of human behavior they might display; what I want to do would at the very least be equianimous, if not outright beneficial for them. And that is why I never try to act, everything that exists in the world, exists in the taking, Everything satisfies so great a need that somebody might be feeling at this particular moment. And I really cannot bring myself to snatch a child’s toy no matter how much I really want to play with it. It just is wrong << I don’t really have needs>> I try to increase the values of these off terms in a way such as to be as fair as I can possibly be.

Thus, I find it extremely nauseating when others take things that should by rights belong to somebody who needs them more. I like to type with a keyboard, because it is a music I can see the feedback of it directly on a screen, I don’t really have to listen to arbitrary shite like frequencies and keys and notes and chords and boring tiring taxing things like tuning the fucking guitar I want to play it. You see, in my mind I have it figured out, I can simply change the intervals and play it as effortlessly as I want to. << I do that when I think the moon is feeling rather blue.>> But mostly I do not want to find in my the strength of conviction to act, because I am still getting the narrative of my life straight, so I think, I might just die just in my mind, trying to find the exact pitches I want to execute every phoneme I want to pronounce and never quite get it to “soun righ”.

Part of the problem lies with the fact that I read newtonian mechanics before quantum. Well, I get the idea that they wanted to develop a historical perspective. But every book that I as a young boy on qm that I managed to get my hands on would begin with a preface entitled why qm is hard. The only guy who didn’t seem to be sharing the popular measure of the hardability of qm seemed to me to be Richard Feynman and I read his lectures. Many sets of many times “over”. I read it everywhere I went and as many times as I could. When I found something so no bull as the “principle of uncertainity” I wanted to make it mine, because deep in my mind I had realized that newtonians were doomed to fail simply because they wanted to measure everything, and while that is a noble pursuit; numbers are meaningless really. It is only a very interesting belief that there can be ever two things that are the same.

I mean to know the effect a man has on earth when he walks, you need to remove all the other interfereing humains and then whatever remains is what is the force that binds the two of them together.

I sometimes find the courage to admit to myself that I can only think in english because the work I learned mathematics from, was actually written in english. Thus for me patterns of written english are another form of mathematics. In other words they are exactly equivalent. This is why I hate to do sums, because I think I might arrive at conclusions that do not really match what the other people are getting and I can never really be sure of how deep the conspiracy goes and how much do I really know and other questions like that. Or that even the parameters to which I pride myself so for being able to exactly constraint my behavior even exist. I am not really sure why I am “broadcasting this on all available frequencies”.

I did not really find my own sequences or even a basis for generating those sequences, I understand everything from an uncertain unsaid context. The phrases that occur together share the same context. So I just imagine whatever I want to imagine and my body does this thing where my lips start moving and I start to talk, I don’t really comprehend how that happens and everytime I do it, I end up equally surprised. I don’t seem to have picked up much from induction. And I don’t really need anything more than that. I can tune to any well really, so I don’t really care either way.

And I was happy, really happy, I had found what I thought was a very satisfactory “role” to play. Because see I enjoy playing. And I don’t qyite onkw what really I am optimizing to, but there is one starting revelation I had today. I can really solve anagrams pretty fucking quickly and I try not to notice that by taking as huge a pause as I think should be appropriate.

So today I bought this book that goes by the name the catcher in the rye by jd salinger.. I could not really comprehend the need extra unnecessary “the” because anytime I need to call for the book, do I go like <<give me the the catcher in the rye>> it sounds painfully absurd. It rhymes somwhat, but that effect really does absolutely fucking nothing to resolve this compilation error.

See, because I don’t really think if two humans actually tried communicating they would pass the Turing test, and I never really want to do anything that ends up leading to anyone pointing to me and saying << oh look you failed again, it was your fault anyways>>

Ergo when I see catch her in the eyes by ida lingers, I just have to buy that won’t I?

item.title: The Curse of Morning Assemblies
item.dc:creator: basyt
item.content:encoded:
They made me fvking hate the mornings. I usually don’t mind morinings. It is one of those things that passes if you ignore them. Sure they’d be back again the next morning begging you to rise saying things like see today is going to be a GOOD day and whatnot, but I have interacted with enough proselytizers to know better. So I just turn over and go back to sleep, I usually sigh and it comes out as meh. So whatever.

Anyways, when I was in school I could not really afford to do that, I had ahem my whole future ahead of me and schooling was going to make it or break it for me. So my dad would say that do you want to end up a rickshaw puller. And I did not really mind rickshaw pullers, they are nicely kind blue gents but the physical exertion is SO demanding and they get up at 4 in the morning and get to the campus and drive around hoping somebody might be out and they could take them from gate to hall or hall to gate and make 10 bucks or so. But see, it is winters and nobody except for the 10 pointers + jai shri krsna + fajr namaz folks get up that early. But they all have ulterior motives for getting up that early.

There of course are also people like me, who love night outs and to smoke and to play cs, dota, aoe or whatever it is that the new generation is calling it, and the god awful shitty tea they serve at mt. But then we are not likely to get to mt before the shops open and that usually is after 6. And I don’t think anybody of these would ever hail a rickshaw. We move like packs of wolves or every once in a while hyenas.

But anywyas, I am rather more interested in a long bygone era when I was still in school in the 9th class. I must have done something right because they had seen it fit to appoint me School Prefect. THere were nine other people with whom I shared this dubious honor, because then I thought that being Indians they did not know the spelling of perfect.

Still I got into a fight with a friend of mine, who was the school vice captain, I say fight but I got my ass handed over to me. But I don’t really mind the thrashing I received because he is now in the navy and just knowing that he is out there, I feel safer.

Events somehow snowballed and pretty soon there was a whole inquiry setup, because if the head boy of vices was fighting with one of the school perfects, it doesn’t bode well for the school.

And then I came to the school as usual, I do not really recollect the order of things. But then this rather self important teacher came up to me. He always had this aura of dread around him and just looking at him in class made me forget the answers to the questions that he was asking. So I used to wear this shiny little badge that said School Prefect I think it was blue and I was always cleaning it when nobody would be looking at me. So the teacher said hand over your badge. And I really did not want to. I mean I got the whole sequence of events as they had happened, he had just asked the other guy for his so I knew they had decided that the best course of action was as always recrimination and we were both going to get “debatched”. And I actually did not mind getting debatched, all the responsibility that a school prefect ever had was to stand in attention during the assembly, the special ones went on for like hours and they were sheer torture under the summer sun for everybody from the youngest kid to eldest adults and once a couple of kids fainted everybody discovered that they could get out that way. And I would stand, rapt at attention looking at all these fucking kids who would pretend to get fainted and I know pretend because most of them were also trying to avoid getting hurt while falling while doing so. So I remember there was this one time when I told myself enough is enough, an hour long assembly is more than is sufficient. So I did the most logical thing, I fainted. But since I was standing next to the people conducting the assembly, I was in full view of the whole populace, but I just wanted to see if I can act it out convincingly enough. So I fell and I think I hurt myself a bit, and even if my fainting was fake, my pain was actual so I think I deserved a trip to the school infirmary( it was that modern a school, it didn’t have diaries it had almanacs, they actually had a nursing room with a nurse and a couple of beds and they called it an infirmary and you were supposed to carry a pocket dictionary that there is no pocket huge enough to carry to school everyday. All kids ever did with that was to look up bad words like penis and vagina).

Anyways, back to the teacher student correspondence. I just didn’t want to give my badge( I used to pronounce it batch then because I didn’t yet know the fidderence) because I had already decided that I was going to keep it with me forever. So I wanted to say something like I quit being a prefect and I am never coming to an assembly again, I would RATHER sit in the library anyways. Somehow I always enjoyed being around books than people and I didn’t quite know why. Now I sort of do. Anyways, I knew that a couple of slaps were inevitable no matter what I did. So I wanted to ask him why would you slap me or something along those lines and I only managed to get as far as Why before I found that strangely I had lost the ability to speak. The slap was swift and I could tell that the teacher actually did try to hold himself back as much as he could, the embarrassment of being slapped hurt a lot more. If I knew the word then, I would have asked for a guillotine you know. So anyways. That’s that. Then this girl whose kindness I always mistook for something more came to me and said that I should go hide in the infirmary. So I went to the infirmary and lay down on a bed. And I did what I always do. I examined the chain of events that led to the slap and I told myself, never, ever in my life am I going to do something that would result in me getting slapped. And I don’t remember getting slapped again. But the future seems uncertain.

item.title: Once upon a time on a morning long long ago
item.dc:creator: basyt
item.content:encoded:
There was another morning assembly and I was still to be debatched I think. And it was a special one. And at that time my house Ganges was conducting the assemblies. It was pretty much like the Hufflepuff we were always at the fvking bottom and goddam we were having fun there. I seriously hope they have figured out “how to win” by now though.

I thought it was very apt that the house I was a captain of was called Ganges(that was when I was in class 8th, about a year before the time I was briefly perfect) as I was pretty much born on its bank, well I was born in a nursing home and it is pretty close to the ganges. Well all of my birth place really is. And even today the home of my parents is hardly a couple of kilometers from the ganges. My highschool was run by Catholics and was called St. Michaels High School and it was a pretty huge building and had been established sometime in the 1860’s so it was old enough to garner a LOT of respect from me.

But anyways this event took place in the time I was still in my 9th grade and I think it was after the whole debauchery of debadging or whatever. The day before this incident a teacher had come to me and told me that I was supposed to be conducting the special assembly the next morning. She wore a saree with a very low cut back and in that moment I could not really find in me the courage to say no to her request. I had seen hundreds of these assemblies and I knew them as exactly as a mathematical equation. But, see, I wanted to impress her I guess or maybe wow the whole school, or something along those lines. Or maybe it was because I had read of Cicero and I decided that I wanted to try my hand at the noble art of Oratory. So I spent the whole night thinking about all the things I could talk about. There is this festival that only bihari hindus seem to celebrate called Chatth( I never quite figured out an appropriate english translation for it) so anywyas, maybe its because they’re the only ones celebrating it, that they try to make it last for weeks I think to make it more significant. At my home we just really “celebrate” two festivals Id-ul-Fitr and the Id-ul-Zuha I say celebrate but the most jubliant I have seen grown up muslims act is when they hug each other after the prayers. It might just be because the prayers on Id are the longest, it’s a two rikaat namaaz and my brother and I can easily do that in less than two minutes when we are racing each other to the finish, but the Id ones seem to just go on and on and then there is the qutba where the imam drones on half asleep about the virtues of piety or whatever he could think of. We do cook something on muharram, but we don’t celebrate it, because we are Sunni muslims and not Shias. And shias don’t “celebrate” so much as “mourn” muharram. And some of them self mutilate in full public view on air and I used to thank god that I was not born a Shia because I don’t like the sight of blood. Or the accompanying pain for that matther.

So anyways the stage is set. And I enter the stage and stand up in front of the mike. I am going to wow them I decide. They are all looking at me expectantly but their eyes are bored. Oh I realize, they really want to hear one of those formula assemblies. Oh I realize, I am the only one who was looking forward to this. Oh I realize, there isn’t a real thing I want to say. I don’t even know what I want to say and what I don’t. So I begin with the most obvious of words Happy and I intend the next to be the name of the festival. But somehow it felt so crude, these aren’t the words of the saim language. They don’t make the same kind of music because their accents are different. And I pause and everybody is looking at me. It is going down like a fucking lead zeppelin if you don’t mind the pun. So with enormous trepidation I try to pronounce the first syllable it’s a Cha and I could think of two possibilities of pronouncing that, before I move ahead I realize I have said the wrong one, so I try the other one, and then I realize the first one was actually correct, so I try that again and then I realize that I did not even change I just tried the same pronunciation all three times and I decide it was sufficient to say it thrice and move on to the second one. It’s a tha sound that really doesn’t exist in english.

And then I stop, this whole experience has been a tremendous exertion for me. And I can hear everybody laughing and the strictest of teachers are trying hard to hide their smiles. And then I realize, they are laughing at me. So that gives me some confidence, because there is apparently only so low that one can fall. So in a voice devoid of any expression whatsoever, I say the formula, they cut to a prayer. And in the first break my english teacher came up to me and made me write down what to do. I did that under protestation, I knew what follows what, I did not to look at a piece of paper for that. Anyways I would just look at it and announce whatever was next. It was brutally short, I didn’t give any crap about how beautiful the morning was today and I didn’t mention how many of the kids faint in an average assembly. So I kept it as neutral and free of bullshit as I could.

That assembly was as far as I can remember the shortest of all special assemblies that I participated in.

The assembly got over and the class clowns came over and started repeating my first four syllables to me. And I could never really figure that out. Were they so impressed by my preformance that they wanted to acknowledge it? Or were they making fun of me? Either way I’ve always thought of it as pretty apish behavior(which technically it is, to copy is to ape), anyways I smiled. I always smile when I don’t know what the appropriate behavior in that situation might be. It I have noticed prevents conflict escalation. So I always smile as hard as I can. And I never really had a beef with that crowd. If anything they always were upto something that made classes fun and my days interesting. Come to think of it, I actually do sometimes find myself missing their company.

So apparently I have to go code, so that I could write a paper, that which if selected(though technically the chances of not being selected are rather dim) goes to the Annual Conference of the Canadian Nuclear Society at Niagra Falls and then comes out in their journal called the Fusion Research and Technology. And all of those words sound righteously important and I have my fingers crossed that I might actually get to go see the Niagra Falls(I have some family and Canada and they have assured me that it is the best thing the planet has to offer, but I have seen smaller falls and this is only bigger but not big enough to be a sigularity.) Anyways it might be fun, technically speaking, I have always wanted to interact with fusion science people to find out why they aren’t working on a fusion engine already. Steam power is so 1800’s. Somehow I can never ask my guide this, because it feels not right asking him and there is always the possibility that he might say no. Which is the word I like the least in all of english. Anyways my parents are thinking of going to Canada this summer, so I might just tag along with them. But that would feel like a failure, because I always want to travel as lonely as I possibly can. It might be because I might have accidently seen too much of this lonely planet as a child.

item.title: Growing up is a bitch
item.dc:creator: basyt
item.content:encoded:
I never really did want to grow up. I blame peter pan for that. See he one day had to leave neverland and all. And I read that and I felt this cold shiver run up me, I thought when I grew up I would have to use all these big words and marry and earn and get angry on poor people and be nice to “the boss” all that, so I came up with what was in my mind a very elegant solution. I decided I wasn’t going to grow up. But see, the problem is all that is fine until the planning stages only. Your blood starts to yearn and you start to feel it move and everytime you conform and not say the things on your mind you get angry. And for me anger is the one true mark of growing up. My father for example, he gets angry on very little things that should not be of any consequence. And my mother and my brother get embarrassed by it. But I understand him as perfectly as only a son can understand his father. And maybe he does too. Maybe he really comprehends me as well as only a father can comprehend his son. And I can see why the anger arises. He likes things in a particular way. Suppose we were to go to a restaurant. We did not really do that much often, my mother’s claim was that we just have to tell her what we want to eat and she would make it. And while some of it was placebo and some of it the hypnosis of suggestibility and some of it surely was the mother's love lets say, but everything she cooks is fucking awesome.

So anyways, one of the realizations that comes with growing up is that, rules really do exist for being broken. But that is no fun, its like playing a video game with cheat codes.

So today something interesting happened. I was as I am often when I want to “think deeply about the problems of existence and other such absurdities” smoking a cigarette, and over time I have gotten used to my natural habitat, which  is the office of mechanical engineering dept. above the nuclear labs.

Now it is a singularly bad idea, because there are all these profs who have been here loner. And also for longer. And by god do they disapprove of it. There is a walkway that connects the office to the toilet(well there are other labs on that side but I only ever go there to piss, so its not like those really exist). And in my own naïve mind I decided that I own the walkway. So I sometimes read there, and listen to the conversations that the people are having below over a cup of coffee, in other words I feel somewhat closer to godhood.

Now I was standing there and looking at these ledges, and I had the craziest idea, I thought if I was really the prince of persia which is a delusion I entertain with varying degrees of skepticism; and I was really evaluating how badly I would get hurt if I actually were to try that, and I felt EYES on the back of my head. And it was by pure instinct, it is something I am discovering these days, my blood tells me things if I listen to the way it flows. And I can tell when it is unturbulent and there is not a single perturbed thought in my head. At moments like these I find the strange conviction to actually do the things I want to do. So anyways, not only did I feel the eyes, I even knew to not look. But I looked and I sighed. It was one of those old profs you know, not the kind elder folks who are brimming with wisdom and who actually want to help sad lonely students like me but the very opposite, a creature so full of hatred and self loathing I wonder if he gets off on that. And I also think of such old people as potential fossil fuel. But anyways, I KNEW he is coming to have a word with me. And I turned to move away and he shouted, hey you are not supposed to smoke here. And my first instinct was to jump from the walkway. It is not very high, I did not want to kill myself or anything in case you were wondering, I have actually jumped from that high once before with this friend called Syed Yaser Ali (eh is a pretty cool guy. draws morrison and doesn’t afraid of anything) and the ground below is pretty soft so it wasn’t like I was afraid of getting hurt either. But I decided I wanted to behave humanely. So the first thing that occurred to me was, I should throw the butt in the dustbin. And I have never done that. Even in my room I only do that if I remember, my instinct is to just lazily throw it away. So anyways, I took the stairs and I knew he was following, and he would end up having a word. Polite, I must be polite I told myself. I have had a couple of interactions with this professor before. Once in my second year I went to ask him for a summer project and I had really no conviction at all of doing that and I did not really even want to do something so bourgeois. So he reduced me to tears, and I was in my second tear. Anyways I only cried twice more after that, once in my third year, when I was doing pretty badly in a course I was one of the bottom three and the prof(who is a kind man who was the dugc when I was in my second semester and on academic probation for reasons best known to the gods themselves) called me over to find out why me performance was so poor and I did get a C on that course so I think I did do well in the end sems. And the other time was rather recent, but that is a story for some other spacetime.

Anyways, this  prof, the potential fossil, he came up to me and put his arms on my shoulders, and I don’t know why he did that, and I don’t think he has ever been this kind to me. But he asked me a rather strange question, what planet are you from? I mean the answer is obvious isn’t it? I don’t really have to answer it? I just really wanted to say the nastiest possible words of disagreement to him, but there really aren’t any such words in any human language. So I smiled my confusion. So he is saying things to me and I am really like really trying to listen to them, but I don’t really think anything in moments like these and all the words just take this path from one ear to the next. Anyways he runs into another one of those kind profs I earlier talked about, and he complains about me to him, this guy he says, he really is smoking all over the place or something and I could tell this isn’t going to end well and now I don’t really have a business with anything anymore, you don’t go talking to profs of your own volition, its like the first rule of iitk or something. So I go to the wash basin to wash my teeth to get the stink of cigarettes off my teeth. I don’t really know why I smoke them, all I have managed to come up with is that I somehow actually enjoy smoking a cigarette. Which must be a great word of encouragement for the tobacco industry. But what they don’t know is that I am planning to quit at the earliest. So anyways, I had overheard a bit of their conversation because they were not very careful, fossil had said to the kind one: you know there is this saying in french, the more things change the more they stay the same.

And if you say it in english, there is not a lot of proof you are offering of its origination, it might have originated in norwegia for all I care. So anyways, I think my biggest fault is that I am allured by the prospect of knowing things. And I was going to beg and apologize to the prof. Because really I have only been here for like 6.something years. And they have been here far longer, I started wondering what the place was like before the internet and stuff. And I am silly that way I think, I imagine something and then the rest of my body starts moving on its own. I was going to go up to them apologize and ask about it. So I actually did go up to them and it is very foolish and there actually are no words in any language for how stupid this was, its like tickling a lion( I do have this memory of going to a zoo when I was very young and tickling a lion, but that could be a figment of my imagination too, because I find it very hard to separate the imagination and reality of my memories) it wasn’t going to end well. I went up and I didn’t even apologize, I said something weird again, its almost like a nervous tick, I think when I use words like weird and interesting. I said sir you were saying something interesting about how the more this place changes the more this remains the same, and I was going to say that I have decided that it is not a good idea to smoke in places where people are passing and that I REALLY do want to know what the place was like before I came here. But see, he got up, okay and he said something like stop irritating me. I got scared, my future is very uncertain and I would like to stay here a couple more months and complete my raship. And I can tell even the kind prof was angry, I can tell things like these about the people I know, so I can tell, and I don’t like to make people I know angry, it makes me feel like I somehow failed at life or something. But this passive aggressive bullshit from the fossil, it is more than I can handle. I was seething with anger and I just wanted to get to my room because I know where everything is in my room and there are no hidden unknowns and nothing to be scared of. Nothing can go wrong, I sometimes tell myself while I am still in my room. I have this notion that as long as I am in my room I am like the cat of schrodinger, I don’t really exist to the world outside and I am neither alive nor dead. But some kind of a zombie vampire or something.

So while my legs were taking me to the room, I came to stop near hall one, lit a cigarette and found myself wondering why did the chicken cross the road? and in my mind I found an explaination. And on my face was the smile that only ever comes when I KNOW something. And I am not telling what I know very easily.

item.title: Satisfied Blues
item.dc:creator: basyt
item.content:encoded:
It is a song by Mississippi John Hurt. He looks like a very affable kind fella. He lived in an era of which the fragrance still lives on in his songs, and when I hear his clear guitar I feel I am in delta listening to his audience clapping.

The there is Creep by Radiohead. It is such a good song that they apparently hate performing it. It is a very creepy song. There is a flash vid of an acoustic performance that pronoy once showed me and I try to hear to it at least once every day. Every song I like, I try to hear at least once a day. I like too many songs and I listen to them pretty much constantly while I work, think, write and other things.

What makes a song good? I have often wondered. I don’t really get my generation and they listen to Justin Bieber and Ke$ha and I tried listening to a song by Ke$ha where she claimed she brushes her teeth with a Jack Daniels and I thought that cannot be a very healthy activity in the long run. And I don’t really get why jB(is that the way it is written I don’t know) is so popular. I mean sure he has all the makings of a star, but I don’t think that is any reason to get famous by itself. See I like things of an era where people actually did something, like Jimi Hendrix, or Kurt Cobain. I sort of lost track of where things after that, though there are a couple of songs here and there.

There is this song called Ain’t no rest for the wicked by a band called Cage the Elephant. I have not tried listening to other songs by them. This played at the start of Borderlands, and I was pleasantly surprised by the slide guitar solo on the song, because I thought after autotune, we really sort of forgot that there were such exotic ways of actually playing songs with instruments meant to play songs.

Then there are chip tunes and there is this album I once heard, where somebody uploaded to youtube, the whole of the dark side of the moon done in chip tunes and it was so reminiscent of super mario bros and megaman other such games of a long bygone era, that I just listened to the songs in rapt attention. Their creator once commented something to the effect that the square wave is infinitely expressible or something similar. And I found myself agreeing, because see any wave packet can be written as a fourier series of infinite terms and a square step function would have a very pleasing mathematical form too, I think, unlike the normal analog sounds that are okay I am starting to spout bull. But it was nice.

Then there is Summertime. It has so many versions and each is so different and enjoyable. There is the one by Janis Joplin and every jazz band seems to have done a version of it. But there is something so unique about the Ella Fitzgerald Louie Armstrong jugalbandi you know, it is really awesome just listening to it, I find myself singing along, and I don’t really think that I contribute to the sound in any particular way. But the way Ella goes So hush little baby don’t you cry and the way Louie replies One of these mornings you gonna rise up singing, yes you spread your wings and take to the skies. But till that morning… I sometimes get up early in the morining just so I could sing this song.

Then there is Cherub rock by the smashing pumpkins and I don’t really know the name of the guys in the band, but the lead singer/guitarist has this unique style of playing the guitar where he strums with one hand and his other hand he is technically just changing chords, but he sometimes does it in such a way that it approaches a solo. And he has a rather soft effeminte voice, not the falsetto of robert plant or one of those hairy metal bands() but it is more of a fact that he doesn’t really have a very deep voice and even his low notes don’t go very far down.

Musically I have been involved with the works of Neil Young for the longest period of time. I think, I am not sure about these matters. But I am always spread too thin in my interests so it is quite possibly true. And I don’t really know earlier why he wasn’t that famous. I think I got it only after I saw him playing. He gets lost in his music and whatever he plays, he finds it beautiful, because well it is his expression and he cannot really find any faults in it. Faults are something that only fans can find, really. When he moved to electric guitars everybody was shocked apparently, how dare he play folk rock on an electric guitar? And never in my life have I heard a more absurd proposition. What does it matter?

There is this very unique proposition that has been made, by the new generation, a conundrum, what kind of a vampire glitters in the sun. Earlier I only felt disgust for such a notion. But bishonen vampires are nothing new, the guys in Black Blood Brothers are bishonens, as are the vampires in Underworld, perhaps the earliest sighting of a bishonen vampire was the one called Angel on Buffy the Vampire Slayer. It is just the glittering part that people really are uncomfortable with. And it is not very hard to understand why. Little girls for reasons I don’t really comprehend, like glittery things. And Stephenie Meyer is either catering to the crowd or writing slashfic(putting herself in bellas shoes) or outright fanfic(there already is a set that likes glittery things and she is catering to them the best she can).

But then I was wondering if there is a vampire that might actually glitter and under what conditions is that transformation achieved? And as all answers, it is obvious, a vampure who only drinks his own blood to satiate his own thirst need not fear the sun, for then the shroud that covered the corpus christi is his shield. Such a noble beast, I wonder if it exists.

Then there is of course the Thrill is gone version by BB King and Gary Moore. I have not really listened to more songs by Gary Moore mostly because of something that George Carlin said, he asked, what has the white man got to be blue about? But I don’t think blueness has anything to do with the color of the skin. Indian gods are always demonstrated as having a blue skin, so I felt why I was not worthy of sharing that? I later found out that I am not really a hindu god so I don’t get to share that honor and then avatar was released and grossed megabucks and some claimed that it is a rehashing of the old movies like the one called danced with the wolves but got bored eventually or something. And some claim it is a Scathing critique of Western Imperialism. Whichever way it made many people extremely wealthy. I saw the movie with my brother. And all the way I thought I was going to watch Avatar the Last Airbender and I didn’t really remember that Manoj N Shyamalan was the one who was directing that movie. So I waited expectantly, I had seen Lord of the Rings so I thought that Hollywood likes to take a certain creative liberty with the way it interprets its sources. After all once Emma Watson grew up they have apparently gone on to show a dream sequence where she kisses the guy who plays Harry potter. I haven’t seen the movies so it mightn’t be very accurate. But something of this sort happened. And I only ever saw one half episode of Airbender, so I was not very perturbed by the space travel, I fully expected some sort of an Airbender/Alien crossover as signorey weaver was also in the movie. So but when the last few minutes were approaching, well actually it was the fucking sex scene and I was like, where is the promised airbender? And during that scene I sort of realized, that this is not quite the movie I came in to watch, and I enjoyed the movie, I have never seen a movie I didn’t enjoy, except for hum aapke hain kaun? WHich was pure torture it is about a marriage, once all Indian movies seemed to be about marriages and all the little games that went around them, and it is a pretty accurate potrayal, about as much accurate as History always is, if not more. 

And lately I have been thinking. All one really needs is a context. A context makes everything meaningful.But then there are people, like the Mongols and the Vikings. And at least some of my blood really is mongol, and I had always sort of thought of ming the merciless(flash gordon) as an archetype of mongols. Meesum was telling me that they would do shit like killing people and making a mountain out of their dead bodies. And then they discovered Islam. They became fucking sufis. Now I don’t really remember what sufi means, but when I was child I remember somebody saying that my behavior is very sufiyana. So since I don’t really hurry about things, I think of it as being calm, and for the longest of times, I ignored the cries of my blood, because I was scared of what I might do if I started to listen to it, because it wants me to do crazy things that I have never done before. I went today morning to the mt, and there was a dog there and I feed them alright, but it is always like I throw food at a begging dog, but this one was a poor dog even among the mongrels and it had this thing on its eyes, that looks like the kind of eye dust you get when you wake up with early in the morning. But it was coagulated and looked somewhat disgusting. And I gave in. I touched the poor things head and I could feel it communicate with me, well it is a possibility that it was just a figment of my imagination. And I don’t really like ignoring possibilities, no matter how much remote they might seem at the moment. I have a compulsive need to plan for everything. but in that moment, I just let my hands move by themselves, and I found my hands wiping the dog’s eyes and ears. And I only used my left hand, because my right hand got hurt  night before last when I jumped inside the campus school for no real particular reason. It isn’t the first time I have done that, I have done that a couple of times before in my first and second years. But I had stopped doing that when I realized that if I were to get caught, the fine gents of SIS would come to only two possible conclusions a) it is right next to hall 6 and that is very bad, but not bad as be) ing thought of as a fucking pedo. And there is in my mind no real depth you could sink to below that. I mean I would sooner rather die, you know, than ever do anything like that.

But it feels nice to do things that I do without thinking of the conclusions. In those moments somehow I always end up behaving the way I used to as a child. And there is something very satisfying about that. As a child I used to watch all these b grade horror flicks and kids would tell all these stories that were apparently very “sacry” and I would find them funny and didn’t really learn the difference between funny and scary until I had failed a couple of times. And nothing else really scared me, ever. But I really really hate to fail. It somehow prevents me from ever doing anything I really want to. but the entropy of the universe seems to increase no matter what I do. And that shouldn’t happen. Everything else is conserved, whhyyy is entropy not constant, I wondered for the longest period of time. And despite remonstrations I found myself going to attend a golden jubilee lecture on entropy from a mathematical pov. And I had as always my mind was felt with only the grandest of designs. Once I comprehend entropy mathematically I thought, that is all. Then I would know everything. I told myself. And I was making these grand designs about how I would be able to actually completely predict human behavior. And sure I says to myself I would never be able to predict the movement of a single being, that is just not how statistics works. It is technically impossible to do that. But on huge ensembles of 6 billion people, maybe more. And I convinced myself, that humans really do move like herds, each either copies left or copies right or the braver ones take some sort of a linear combination. And it is a flow, sure it is turbulent, but it is a flow. And people take the most obvious paths. Take the bicycle tracks that lead out from the library towards the cc canteen. Everybody doesn’t take the shortest paths, they take the most convenient path, which is pretty much the same. And arguing such things, I arrived to the lecture. I didn’t really hear any word, though I tried, lectures always seem to just bounce elastically of my ears. Oh and you see, my wisdom teeth was coming out, so it was very painful. And the realization that I am 24 and two months and it is probably somewhat late to be getting wisdom teeth at this age, was somewhat embarrassingly painful. And I was really thinking things just so you know to take my mind of things. But see I did realize something, that still makes me smile. Entropy is exactly the same thing as a game of hide and seek.
